page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a high-capacity general-purpose virtual machine within the Enhanced server family, driven by a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 72 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. Memory is sized at 288.0 GB, establishing a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not feature hardware GPU acceleration and contains no bundled local storage, requiring all persistent storage volumes to be attached as remote network disks. Networking throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

Resource allocation matches the requirements of large-scale enterprise applications, high-concurrency microservices architectures, data aggregation, and multi-tenant hosting where consistent compute and balanced RAM capacities are essential. The architectural tradeoff centers on network-attached storage dependence, making network optimization vital for data-heavy operations.
